Here are simplified definitions for the technical terms in the text:

**Photosynthesis**
This is how plants make their own food. They use sunlight as energy to turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar (food) and release oxygen into the air. It is the main way plants grow and provides the oxygen we breathe.

**Chlorophyll**
This is the green pigment found in plants. You can think of it as the plant’s solar panel. It captures sunlight so the plant can use that energy to create food.

**Glucose**
This is a simple type of sugar. It is the main source of energy for living things. When plants make food through photosynthesis, they produce glucose, which they use to grow and stay alive.
